selection.primary: Date-equal mean high/low/range CRPS, equally averaged over 2/5-day horizons and selection folds

checkpoint_candidates: Every second completed epoch plus CE-best; candidates selected on validation only
scope: Reconstruction diagnostics, validation-only sampling choice, then new chronological-window confirmation and checkpoint-selection comparison; further data/capacity work is gated on these findings
reconstruction_interpretation: Actual future tokens are used only for offline distortion measurement; this is not a forecast or a strict lower bound on forecast error
new_window_interpretation: New to this token-path evaluation protocol; retrospective development data with unresolved tokenizer pretraining provenance

checkpoint_selection_rule.primary: Date-equal mean high/low/range CRPS, equally averaged over 2/5-day horizons and selection folds

seed_interpretation: Training seed varies; evaluation stocks and generation RNG are fixed across seeds
sampler_selection_rule: Choose among the four prespecified samplers using seed 17 and 2023 H1 validation only; freeze before 2023 H2 evaluation; later-window audit does not select this setting
evaluation_rule: Compare CE checkpoint/baseline sampler with one change at a time; report all seeds; no evaluation-based choice
